sub_code_0000_0b5a  _DoCode                  ; formerly _main: original MicroProse name (Amiga symbol table, symbols/amiga-names.txt); called from __astart (sub_code_0000_2ac0); runs the whole crypto session: setup, input loop until D_1dbe, writes results back to the shared block
sub_code_0000_0ca4  _GoodBye      ; formerly _signal_quit_game: original MicroProse name (Amiga symbol table, symbols/amiga-names.txt); stores -1 into byte 0 of the shared block (next-module code -1 = leave the whole game, see COVERT's launcher loop); called just before _exit on Alt-Q
sub_code_0000_0cbd  _DoSound     ; formerly _play_sound_effect: original MicroProse name (Amiga symbol table, symbols/amiga-names.txt); calls the sound driver thunk only when option bit 4 (toggled by Alt-S) is set; argument is an effect number (0x13/0x14 off/on cue, 0x2d key, 0x2e decoded)
sub_code_0000_0cd4  _set_display_page      ; int 10h with AH=5 (select active display page), AL=argument; no caller in this module
sub_code_0000_0cf6  _setup_cipher          ; shuffles the cipher alphabet D_105a, clears hint flags, copies the 512-byte message from shared+0200, strips spaces/periods by level, drops last char, uppercases
sub_code_0000_132d  _reveal_hint_letter    ; picks a random used, still unguessed cipher letter and writes the correct plaintext into the guess table; F1 hint and the pre-solved letters of easy levels
sub_code_0000_13a3  _reset_guesses         ; F10: clears every guess except letters already revealed by hints, which get their correct value back
sub_code_0000_1409  _hint_scan_animation   ; F1: plays effect 0x2e and redraws 200 random cipher-text cells with short delays (visual 'searching' effect) before the hint is revealed
sub_code_0000_14d7  _blink_selected_letter ; blinks the letter just typed in the left column (colour 0xe on 3) until a key is pressed, advancing the timer each cycle
sub_code_0000_155a  _crypto_key_step       ; one pass of the workstation input loop: keys ESC, F1, F10, Alt-Q, Alt-S, Alt-P, letter assignment; shows "MESSAGE DECODED"
sub_code_0000_175b  _redraw_guesses        ; redraws the guess column and every text cell with the player's plaintext guess under each cipher letter
sub_code_0000_18a4  _check_solution        ; true when no used letter is wrongly guessed and (unused letters)/2 + correct guesses exceeds 19; same rule as docs/code-protocol.md
sub_code_0000_192e  _draw_timer            ; carries seconds into minutes and writes hh:mm:ss digits into the "00:00:00" string, drawn at (0x100,1)

sub_code_0000_22ff  _start_animation       ; strings "briefing.pan", "bld", "animation.pan": loads a .pan picture animation unless animations are off; no caller in this module

D_chase_3c6a  _lzw_mask  ; (1 << width) - 1 (0b52, 0c4a, 0c98)

D_chase_3c70  _lzw_bits_left  ; bits left in lzw_bits, 8 after init (0b48, 0c44)

D_chase_3c64  _pic_row_bytes_left  ; byte counter of the row being decoded (0b8d, 0be1)
D_chase_3c62  _lzw_saved_sp  ; set to 0x3e75 by lzw_init (0b19), swapped with SP: the decoder uses DGROUP below 0x3e75 as its pixel stack (0b94, 0bf8)
D_chase_245c  _lzw_dictionary  ; 2048 entries of 3 bytes (prefix word, suffix byte), ends at 0x3c5c = pic_width (0b67, 0b77, 0c64)
